images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Tragic ending screen of a diplomatic interpretation game, landscape 16:9. Top-down view of a dark walnut signing desk under a warm pool of light. Two parchment treaty copies lie side by side, slightly rotated: the left one bears a northern wax seal, the right one a southern seal; each has three numbered clauses and an ink signature at the bottom. Clauses 1 and 3 differ in wording between the copies, faintly highlighted in red, with bold red rubber mismatch stamps slammed across the left copy; animated red dashed threads connect the mismatched clauses across the gap. A black fountain pen with brass nib rests between them; small brass-framed counters in the middle. A red emergency glow pulses from the bottom edge, and a black teletype ticker strip runs along the bottom with border incident reports. Large brass gradient serif title at top. Palette walnut brown, parchment, brass, alarm red, navy shadows; grain. Korean UI text: "서명 뒤의 총성", "불일치", "국경 전보". Text constraints: no year or calendar date anywhere on the treaties; signatures are illegible ink scribbles with only the labels "북국 대표" and "남국 대표"; no Latin-alphabet personal names.
